title: Existence of the pointed local map between strict-henselization colimits
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\bar s= g\circ\bar t$. The algebra structures of both point residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] on $\Omega$ are exactly their geometric-point embeddings. Let $C_S,C_T$ be their chosen strict-henselization colimits [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], equipped with local-ring structures, and let $K_S,K_T\subset\Omega$ be the corresponding relative separable closures [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Suppose $\sigma_S:C_S/\mathfrak m_S\simeq K_S$ and $\sigma_T:C_T/\mathfrak m_T\simeq K_T$ are ring equivalences whose induced maps $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}C_S$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}C_T$ have every specified pointed-neighbourhood factorization. There exists a local ring map $h:C_S\to C_T$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] satisfying $j_S\circ\operatorname{Spec}h=g\circ j_T$ for the canonical structural maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] and $\iota_S\circ\sigma_S\circ\operatorname{res}_S=\iota_T\circ\sigma_T\circ\operatorname{res}_T\circ h$ as maps to $\Omega$. This lemma asserts neither uniqueness of $h$ nor its compatibility with arbitrary neighbourhood morphisms.

proof.text: Residue maps of composite scheme morphisms compose. Under the given equations for the Omega algebra maps, the image of kappa(s) lies in the image of kappa(t). Separability is preserved on extending the coefficient field, giving an inclusion K_S -> K_T. Conjugate this inclusion by sigmaS and sigmaT to obtain the required residue-field map.

proof.text: Use local structure and the pointed colimit map to identify the canonical residues and the closed points. The supplied sigma maps agree with those pointed maps, since two such maps agree on all colimit coprojections; cancel the injective embeddings into Omega and the surjective residue maps. Choose an affine open U=Spec A through s. The map g composed with jT from the local T spectrum factors through U, giving an A-algebra structure on C_T. The affine-neighbourhood/triple comparison presents C_S as a filtered colimit of etale A-algebras.

source.place: Tags 04GU and 08HR; etale-cohomology.tex paragraph following Tag 03PS and parent steps 5--7

proof.text: Both maximal ideals contract to the prime of s, and the residue map of the first step respects kappa(s). The T colimit is henselian by its local structure. Apply map_into_henselian_colimit to obtain the A-algebra map h with the prescribed maximal-ideal contraction and residue map. The contraction makes h local; the residue condition gives the displayed equation into Omega. Its A-algebra condition gives the structural-map equation after composing with U -> S.
